description: Normalize, parse, validate and geocode Japanese addresses (住所の正規化・解析・検証) with JPVerify, and look up Japanese postal codes (郵便番号) — down to 丁目, block and building level, with the evidence behind each match. Use when a task involves cleaning or standardizing a Japanese address, checking that an address exists at a required precision, splitting it into components, finding coordinates, or finding the area for a postal code. Paid per call (API key credits or x402).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
